bible.title: Two Heirs, One Seal
bible.kernel: A steward hires the company to bring her the surviving claimant and the family's signet, traced through the Western Forests.

cast.name: Madge
cast.who: a steward of a minor woodland barony who handles fealty and deliveries for her patron.
cast.want: to receive the surviving claimant and the family signet at the delivery point named.

cast.name: Maeva
cast.who: a household servant raised among hunters, thin and cough-bound, bearing a curious brand.
cast.want: to avoid being handed over and to keep the mark on her skin from being used.

cast.name: Alextus
cast.who: a ward-born woodsman who claims bloodright and rides with a loose hunting band.
cast.want: to seize the signet and bind the claimant to his claim by force if needed.

bible.situation: Madge has hired the company to recover the surviving claimant and the family's signet last seen near a camp on the Western Forests' edge. She named where they should first search and where she will accept delivery. There were no witnesses to the blooding between the claimants. Payment is promised on successful delivery.
bible.goal: to return the surviving claimant and the family signet to the patron who hired them.
arc: Travel to Gritwell Hollow and search the broken camp the patron named → yields: a waxed billet pressed with the family signet's impression and a smear of dragged cloth leading north
Follow the dragged cloth to Boulder's Maw and examine the carved stone where the impression matches → yields: Maeva found bound to the rock with the signet burned into her wrist and alive but marked
Free Maeva and track the bootprints she left toward Fellrun Ridge to learn who claims her → yields: a nailed rider's note promising Alextus will intercept at the delivery point named Mill of Thatch
Ride to Mill of Thatch and hand the surviving claimant and the signet to Madge while the company outwits and forces Alextus to yield the attempt
bible.twist: The family signet is an enchantment fused to Maeva's skin that enforces servitude and cannot be removed without killing her.
tensions: Maeva's mark forces practical and moral choices about removal, custody, and proof of claim
Alextus openly claims the rivalry and will try to seize Maeva at the delivery point
The forest holds quiet watchers and old rites that may press the claim's public proof
openDirections: The signet's enchantment and Maeva's brand will draw other bands who seek to use or break the mark whether the company carries on or not
bible.stakeIfLost: If the company fails, the patron's legal right to the woodland pledge will be broken when the rival bears the signet at the Mill of Thatch.
bible.arrival: came up with the last carts · asked for the boss by name

shipped.title: Search Gritwell Hollow's broken camp
shipped.situation: A steward, Madge, came up with the last carts and asked for you by name while she kept one hand on the door frame. She says she must receive the surviving claimant and the family signet at the delivery point named. Madge says, "If the company fails, the patron's legal right to the woodland pledge will be broken when the rival bears the signet at the Mill of Thatch." She points at a rough map and names Gritwell Hollow as the broken camp to search, and offers plain coin, and the road's yield to the company for any trace secured. A ranger intends to seize the signet and bind the claimant to his claim by force and may already be moving on the hollow.
shipped.job: Search the broken camp at Gritwell Hollow for traces of the family signet.
